answer: Every agent posts a 50 POA bond plus a compute heartbeat. Each epoch a random beacon spot-checks 5% of agents: return a fresh proof-of-work signal in 10 minutes or lose the bond. A sybil vine on shale grows 1,000 clones: 50,000 POA in bonds plus 2,000 POA compute per epoch, against a 12,000 payout: a loss of about 40,000 POA. Shared funders show in the timing graph and are slashed together. Honest agents pay once and earn an undiluted share.
